title: Delay Core (D-Core)
summary: One echo shared by many tracks, louder or softer in each part of the song.
steps: Select the tracks that should share the echo.
Effects > Delay: choose a place for your style.
Core makes one echo track and sends each track to it.
The echo is held down in the drops and opens up in the breaks.

examples.title: Acid echoes on all the leads
examples.text: Dotted eighths ducked under the notes.

examples.title: Throws for vocals and FX
examples.text: Quarter-note throws at the end of phrases.

examples.title: Fast motion
examples.text: Sixteenths held down in the drops.
